message: So there I was, hunkered down during that last storm, trying to figure out if I should be more worried about the winds or my family's incessant group chat. My grandson sent a meme about building a fort, while my daughter was busy sharing the latest weather updates (as if I didn’t already have three apps for that). We ended up planning a virtual game night instead of freaking out, which was a welcome distraction. I guess when the weather gets wild, it’s good to remember that laughter can be just as important as flashlights. 🌧️
